name: Masked Heading

style.description: Slide each line up from below the mask, or wipe it open left-to-right.

duration.description: Reveal duration per line, in ms.

stagger.description: Delay between each line's reveal, in ms.

threshold.description: Fraction of the heading visible before the reveal fires.

a11y: The original text stays in a visually hidden .__sr span, read once by assistive tech.
The animated .__visual copy is aria-hidden and duplicates nothing in the reading order.
Each .__line keeps a small padding-bottom so its clipping box never cuts a descender.
The reveal plays once on entry; nothing changes on hover or keyboard focus.
